scripts.build: npm run build --workspace api && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace api" "npm run dev --workspace web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace api && npm run lint --workspace web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace api && npm run test --workspace web
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run package:api && playwright test
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage --workspace api && npm run test:coverage --workspace web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace api && npm run typecheck --workspace web && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
